title: mjscene scene spec v1
description: High-level MuJoCo scene description. Build with: python -m mjscene build <file>

name.description: Identifier used for the output directory ([a-z0-9_-])

title.description: Human-readable title shown in the web scene picker

description.description: Scene purpose, also supplied to AI tools

materials.description: Custom materials outside the preset library

defaults.description: Default contact parameters for all geoms

assemblies.description: Prefabricated assemblies: rooms, tables, stairs, scattered objects, and more

contacts.description: Explicit collision pairs and exclusions for precise contact control

spawn.description: Robot spawn and activity bounds; this framework compiles a site and leaves interpretation to export targets

viewer.description: Web viewer hints that do not affect physics

raw_mjcf.description: Escape hatch: MJCF fragment inserted verbatim inside <mujoco>

timestep.description: Integration timestep (s); <= 0.002 is recommended for rigid contact

cone.description: Friction cone; elliptic is more accurate but slower

impratio.description: Normal-to-tangential impedance ratio; use 10-100 for slipping

wind.description: Wind speed (m/s); requires density or viscosity

noslip_iterations.description: Additional no-slip iterations (5-20 for grasping tasks)

fog_range.description: Override fog start and end distances (m)

pos.description: Position (m); directional lights use only direction

target.description: Light target point; dir is computed automatically

castshadow.description: Cast shadows (at most two shadow lights recommended)

attenuation.description: Point or spot attenuation [constant, linear, quadratic]

preset.description: Lighting preset used when lights is empty

shadow_quality.description: Shadow-map resolution. The web limit is 4096, so ultra only benefitsthe native MuJoCo viewer

lights.description: Explicit lights; overrides preset when supplied

extra_lights.description: Additional lights layered over the preset

amplitude.description: Maximum height variation (m); ground.height_scale overrides it

frequency.description: Noise frequency; higher values produce finer detail

flat_radius.description: Flat radius around the center (m) for robot placement

slope.description: Noise added when kind=slope; height_scale/size determines the actual slope

size.description: Half-size (m); a plane is infinite, so this only affects rendering extent

friction.description: Friction model name or [sliding, torsional, rolling]

condim.description: Contact dimension 1/3/4/6 (defaults to the friction model suggestion)

grid_spacing.description: Third plane size component: rendered grid spacing

elevation_file.description: Use an existing grayscale PNG height map relative to the spec directory

height_scale.description: Height-field z scale (m), equal to maximum elevation. Defaults to terrain.amplitude (or step_height times step_count for steps)

file.description: Use an external image relative to the spec directory

generator.description: Use the framework's procedural texture generator for wood or fabric

params.description: Parameters passed to generator; invalid names report the available options

base.description: Inherit a preset material and override selected properties

texuniform.description: Use world-size uniform texturing (true recommended for ground)

file.description: OBJ/STL path relative to the spec directory; alternative to generator

generator.description: Use the framework's procedural mesh generator for shapes such as rounded boxes

params.description: Parameters passed to generator; invalid names report the available options

maxhullvert.description: Convex-hull vertex limit to reduce collision cost

convex.description: Use a convex hull for collisions (MuJoCo default)

gap.description: Force-free gap inside the contact margin (m). MuJoCo 3.x tests show no effect on resting height; do not use it to cancel margin; set margin to 0 for ground contact

armature.description: Added armature inertia, which can improve stability

limited.description: Whether limited; inferred from range by default

kind.description: dynamic=free motion, static=fixed to world, articulated=jointed

rgba.description: Direct color override of material color

friction.description: Friction model name or three values

collision.description: false means visual only, with no collision

group.description: Visibility group 0-5, hideable in the viewer

children.description: Child objects forming a compound body or chain

tags.description: Tags for viewer or script filtering

size.description: Primary size, interpreted by type (see mjscene list assemblies)

material_2.description: Secondary material, such as tabletop or stair tread

count.description: Count of columns or scattered objects

ceiling.description: Whether the room has a ceiling

dynamic.description: Whether the assembly can move (static by default)

condim.description: Contact dimension 1/3/4/6 (default 4 for scatter and grid_of_boxes)

friction.description: Friction for this contact pair (name or five values)

gap.description: Force-free gap (m); tests show no effect on resting height; see DEFAULTS.gap

pairs.description: Explicit contact pairs; their parameters override geom settings

excludes.description: Disable contact between these two bodies

file.description: Robot MJCF path relative to the spec directory

freejoint.description: Add freejoint to root for a mobile robot

position.description: Robot spawn point; z is the **ground height**. Only the host knows the robot's base height and must add it for the selected robot

clearance.description: Required clear radius around spawn (m), for downstream checks

bounds.description: Activity bounds [x_min,y_min,z_min,x_max,y_max,z_max]; downstream consumers may build invisible walls or choose their own defaults
